text: Ɓen wennjirooɓe hujjaaji meerente e diina Allah jippinaaka e Muhammadu kan, ɓaawo nde yimɓe ɓen nootaade ka, hujja ɓen on, ko meere yanoowo ka Joomi maɓɓe e ka gomɗimɓe ɓen; ɓaɗte woo alanaa mo. Tikkere Allah hino fawii ɓe, sabu yeddugol ɓe ngol saloo goonga, hino woodani ɓe lepte saɗtuɗe, sabbitiiɗe ɓe Ñalnde Darngal.
